+# snap_docker: a docker wrapper that, on the first `docker run`, copies the mounted HOME's
+# .codex/ to $T/snap (mode preserved) before handing over to the stub; the HOME itself is
+# deleted at exit.
+snap_docker() {
+  mv "$T/docker" "$T/docker.inner"
+  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+if [[ "\${1:-}" == run && ! -e "$T/snap" ]]; then
+  prev=""
+  for a in "\$@"; do
+    if [[ "\$prev" == -v && "\$a" == *:/home/evaluser* ]]; then mkdir -p "$T/snap"; cp -a "\${a%%:*}/.codex" "$T/snap/"; fi
+    prev="\$a"
+  done
+fi
+exec "$T/docker.inner" "\$@"
+EOF
+  chmod +x "$T/docker"
+}
+
+@test "container: KF-048 — the per-run auth.json carries the placeholder refresh token (never the host's), keeps every other key, mode 0600; the host file is untouched" {
+  cat > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json" <<'JSON'
+{"OPENAI_API_KEY": null, "auth_mode": "chatgpt", "last_refresh": "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z", "extra": {"k": 1},
+ "tokens": {"access_token": "x.y.z", "refresh_token": "R", "id_token": "i.d.t", "account_id": "acct-1"}}
+JSON
+  local before; before="$(python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json")"
+  snap_docker
+  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
+    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor container --docker-bin "$T/docker"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  local c="$T/snap/.codex/auth.json"
+  [ -f "$c" ]
+  [ "$(stat -c %a "$c")" = 600 ]
+  jq -e '.tokens.refresh_token == "loa-ablation-no-refresh-token"
+         and .tokens.access_token == "x.y.z" and .tokens.id_token == "i.d.t" and .tokens.account_id == "acct-1"
+         and has("OPENAI_API_KEY") and .auth_mode == "chatgpt" and .last_refresh == "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z"
+         and .extra.k == 1' "$c"
+  ! grep -q '"R"' "$c"
+  [ "$(cat "$T/snap/.codex/config.toml")" = "model = 'x'" ]
+  # the host file is byte-identical and still carries its refresh token
+  [ "$(python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json")" = "$before" ]
+  jq -e '.tokens.refresh_token == "R"' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"
+  # no token value reaches the docker argv
+  ! tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/dlog/run-1.argv" | grep -qE 'x\.y\.z|i\.d\.t'
+}

+}

+}

content.content:
+
+# --- KF-048: the per-run HOME carries a codex auth.json with a placeholder refresh token (Sprint 261) ---
+# snap_docker: a docker wrapper that, on the first `docker run`, copies the mounted HOME's
+# .codex/ to $T/snap (mode preserved) before handing over to the stub; the HOME itself is
+# deleted at exit.
+snap_docker() {
+  mv "$T/docker" "$T/docker.inner"
+  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+if [[ "\${1:-}" == run && ! -e "$T/snap" ]]; then
+  prev=""
+  for a in "\$@"; do
+    if [[ "\$prev" == -v && "\$a" == *:/home/evaluser* ]]; then mkdir -p "$T/snap"; cp -a "\${a%%:*}/.codex" "$T/snap/"; fi
+    prev="\$a"
+  done
+fi
+exec "$T/docker.inner" "\$@"
+EOF
+  chmod +x "$T/docker"
+}
+
+@test "container: KF-048 — the per-run auth.json carries the placeholder refresh token (never the host's), keeps every other key, mode 0600; the host file is untouched" {
+  cat > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json" <<'JSON'
+{"OPENAI_API_KEY": null, "auth_mode": "chatgpt", "last_refresh": "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z", "extra": {"k": 1},
+ "tokens": {"access_token": "x.y.z", "refresh_token": "R", "id_token": "i.d.t", "account_id": "acct-1"}}

+# --- KF-048: the per-run HOME carries a codex auth.json with a placeholder refresh token (Sprint 261) ---
+# snap_docker: a docker wrapper that, on the first `docker run`, copies the mounted HOME's
+# .codex/ to $T/snap (mode preserved) before handing over to the stub; the HOME itself is
+# deleted at exit.
+snap_docker() {
+  mv "$T/docker" "$T/docker.inner"
+  cat > "$T/docker" <<EOF
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+if [[ "\${1:-}" == run && ! -e "$T/snap" ]]; then
+  prev=""
+  for a in "\$@"; do
+    if [[ "\$prev" == -v && "\$a" == *:/home/evaluser* ]]; then mkdir -p "$T/snap"; cp -a "\${a%%:*}/.codex" "$T/snap/"; fi
+    prev="\$a"
+  done
+fi
+exec "$T/docker.inner" "\$@"
+EOF
+  chmod +x "$T/docker"
+}
+
+@test "container: KF-048 — the per-run auth.json carries the placeholder refresh token (never the host's), keeps every other key, mode 0600; the host file is untouched" {
+  cat > "$T/home/.codex/auth.json" <<'JSON'
+{"OPENAI_API_KEY": null, "auth_mode": "chatgpt", "last_refresh": "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z", "extra": {"k": 1},
+ "tokens": {"access_token": "x.y.z", "refresh_token": "R", "id_token": "i.d.t", "account_id": "acct-1"}}
+JSON
+  local before; before="$(python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json")"
+  snap_docker
+  run "$PR" --task-yaml "$BUILD" --arm a1_full --run-dir "$T/run" --run-id r1 --trial 1 --source-tree "$T/src" \
+    --suite-file "$T/suite.yaml" --executor container --docker-bin "$T/docker"
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  local c="$T/snap/.codex/auth.json"
+  [ -f "$c" ]
+  [ "$(stat -c %a "$c")" = 600 ]
+  jq -e '.tokens.refresh_token == "loa-ablation-no-refresh-token"
+         and .tokens.access_token == "x.y.z" and .tokens.id_token == "i.d.t" and .tokens.account_id == "acct-1"
+         and has("OPENAI_API_KEY") and .auth_mode == "chatgpt" and .last_refresh == "2026-10-18T00:00:00Z"
+         and .extra.k == 1' "$c"
+  ! grep -q '"R"' "$c"
+  [ "$(cat "$T/snap/.codex/config.toml")" = "model = 'x'" ]
+  # the host file is byte-identical and still carries its refresh token
+  [ "$(python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json")" = "$before" ]
+  jq -e '.tokens.refresh_token == "R"' "$T/home/.codex/auth.json"

+  ! tr '\0' '\n' < "$T/dlog/run-1.argv" | grep -qE 'x\.y\.z|i\.d\.t'
+}

+# --- KF-048: the codex access-token freshness pre-flight (Sprint 261) ------------------------
+# codex_auth <exp offset s> — a crafted auth.json whose access token is h.<base64url({"exp": now+offset})>.s;
+# prints the exp instant (ISO 8601 UTC)
+codex_auth() {
+  python3 -I - "$T/creds/.codex/auth.json" "$1" <<'PY'
+import base64, json, sys, time
+exp = int(time.time()) + int(sys.argv[2])
+pl = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"exp": exp}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
+json.dump({"auth_mode": "chatgpt", "tokens": {"access_token": "h.%s.s" % pl, "refresh_token": "R", "account_id": "a"}},
+          open(sys.argv[1], "w"))
+print(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(exp)))
+PY
+}

+@test "RAB-25 in-flight reservation = running trials x the largest cap among the plan's kinds (DEC-0567): a build trial running in a plan with review-catch reserves 20 (max 27.99 waits, 28 launches); a build-only plan reserves 15 (21.99 waits, 22 launches)" {
+  export STUB_COST=1
+  # seed 5 puts the build trial first; the second gate sees one build trial running and the
+  # review-catch hint 8: 0 + 1 x 20 + 8 = 28 (a per-own-kind rule would give 23, the old cap 20)
+  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,review-01 --trials-build 1 --trials-review 1 --batch kb --concurrency 2 --seed 5 --max-usd 27.99
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  [ "$(jq -r '.plan[0].task_id' "$RES/kb/MANIFEST.json")" = bugfix-v2-02 ]
+  L="$RES/kb/run.log"
+  [ "$(logline 'done kb-a1_full-bugfix-v2-02-t1 ' "$L")" -lt "$(logline 'launch kb-a1_full-review-01-t1 ' "$L")" ]
+  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,review-01 --trials-build 1 --trials-review 1 --batch kc --concurrency 2 --seed 5 --max-usd 28
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  L="$RES/kc/run.log"
+  [ "$(logline 'launch kc-a1_full-review-01-t1 ' "$L")" -lt "$(logline 'done kc-a1_full-bugfix-v2-02-t1 ' "$L")" ]
+  # build only: 0 + 1 x 15 + 7 = 22
+  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,bugfix-v2-05 --trials-build 1 --batch kd --concurrency 2 --max-usd 21.99
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  first="$(jq -r '.plan[0].run_id' "$RES/kd/MANIFEST.json")" second="$(jq -r '.plan[1].run_id' "$RES/kd/MANIFEST.json")"
+  L="$RES/kd/run.log"
+  [ "$(logline "done $first " "$L")" -lt "$(logline "launch $second " "$L")" ]
+  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,bugfix-v2-05 --trials-build 1 --batch ke --concurrency 2 --max-usd 22
+  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
+  first="$(jq -r '.plan[0].run_id' "$RES/ke/MANIFEST.json")" second="$(jq -r '.plan[1].run_id' "$RES/ke/MANIFEST.json")"

+# --- KF-048: the codex access-token freshness pre-flight (Sprint 261) ------------------------
+# codex_auth <exp offset s> — a crafted auth.json whose access token is h.<base64url({"exp": now+offset})>.s;
+# prints the exp instant (ISO 8601 UTC)
+codex_auth() {
+  python3 -I - "$T/creds/.codex/auth.json" "$1" <<'PY'
+import base64, json, sys, time
+exp = int(time.time()) + int(sys.argv[2])
+pl = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps({"exp": exp}).encode()).decode().rstrip("=")
+json.dump({"auth_mode": "chatgpt", "tokens": {"access_token": "h.%s.s" % pl, "refresh_token": "R", "account_id": "a"}},
+          open(sys.argv[1], "w"))
+print(time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime(exp)))
+PY
+}

+  local ru; ru="$(jq -r '.codex_preflight.required_until' "$M")"

+sys.exit(0 if 17600 - 120 < d < 17600 + 5 else 1)' "$ru"

    if v is None and name == "BARE": return tmin("PLAN", task) + tmin("IMPLEMENT", task) + 2 * tmin("FIX", task)

@test "RAB-8 watchdog (DEC-0429): a pipeline that hangs past the deadline (with a running record, or with none) is SIGTERMed and rowed interrupted" {
  rules '*-bugfix-v2-02-* hang' '*-bugfix-v2-05-* hang_norecord'
  export LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_S=2 LOA_ABLATION_WATCHDOG_GRACE_S=2
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,bugfix-v2-05 --trials-build 1 --batch w1 --concurrency 2
  [ "$status" -eq 3 ]   # no trial completed
  [ "$(row w1-a1_full-bugfix-v2-02-t1 | jq -r '.status')" = interrupted ]
  [ "$(row w1-a1_full-bugfix-v2-05-t1 | jq -r '.status')" = interrupted ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.synthesized_by' "$RES/w1/a1_full/bugfix-v2-05-t1/meta/pipeline.json")" = run-ablation.sh ]
  [ "$(grep -c 'watchdog: .* SIGTERM' "$RES/w1/run.log")" -eq 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.per_arm.a1_full.excluded' "$RES/w1/STATUS.json")" = 2 ]
  # every interrupted trial without a reported cost is charged the run cap
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.assumed_cap_trials' "$RES/w1/STATUS.json")" = 2 ]
}

@test "RAB-9 --max-usd: USD 5 per trial under max 12 launches two (0+7 hint, 5+5) and cuts the third (10+5 > 12) with cuts[] populated; exit 1" {
  export STUB_COST=5
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,bugfix-v2-05,bugfix-v2-06,bugfix-v2-07 --trials-build 1 --batch c1 --concurrency 1 --max-usd 12
  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
  S="$RES/c1/STATUS.json"
  [ "$(wc -l < "$T/stub.log")" -eq 2 ]
  [ "$(jq -c '.cuts' "$S")" = '[{"reason":"max_usd","spent":10,"in_flight_reserved":0,"max":12,"est_next":5,"trials_launched":2,"at_trial":3}]' ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.state' "$S")" = partial ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.spend.spent_usd, .spend.max_usd' "$S" | tr '\n' ' ')" = "10 12 " ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.resume_cursor' "$S")" = 2 ]
  grep -q 'cut: max_usd 12 reached after 2 trials' "$RES/c1/run.log"
}

@test "RAB-10 --resume: an interrupted batch (STATUS mid-plan, two rows, one stale run dir) resumes without duplicate run_ids and finishes" {
  ra --arms a1_full --tasks bugfix-v2-02,bugfix-v2-05,bugfix-v2-06,bugfix-v2-07 --trials-build 1 --batch r1 --concurrency 1
  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.tools' "$M")" = "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.phase_models.REVIEW' "$M")" = "global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.pre_registration_ref' "$M")" = "NOTES ## Pre-registration 2026-10-15T08:00:00Z" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.suite_manifest_sha256' "$M")" = "$(python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],"rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256")" ]
  [ "$(jq -r '.refused | length' "$M")" = 1 ]
  # the watchdog deadline is twice the phase-sum timeout. Suite v2 build tasks carry bounds
  # timeout_min {IMPLEMENT: 35}: A1 build 15 + 35 + 30 + 15 + 30 + 15 = 140 min, A4 build 15 + 35 = 50,
  # A1 review-catch (no bounds) 60. A0 BARE stays 70 min: the suite's phase_defaults declares BARE,

  [ "$(jq -r '[.plan[] | select(.arm == "a0_bare" and .type == "bug-fix")][0].watchdog_s' "$M")" = 9600 ]   # BARE = 15 + 35 + 2 x 15 on a v2 task (per-task bounds, DEC-0580)

  [ "$(jq -r '[.plan[] | select(.arm == "a1_full" and .type == "review-catch")][0].phase_sum_min' "$M")" = 60 ]

head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1096 — remove_colliding deletes an agent .py file whenever its basename is reserved and its path is not in the fixture or the overlay. It never checks that a same-named module actually exists elsewhere in the grading tree, so nothing has to collide. A refactor or bug-fix that legitimately moves a fixture test (for example tests/test_parser.py → tests/unit/test_parser.py) loses the moved file before the suite runs, so the regression or hidden counts drop for a correct solution. That is the mis-grading 1.2.11 is meant to prevent.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1093 — The collision rule is too broad. It matches every agent .py file anywhere in the tree: non-test source modules, files inside packages (directories with __init__.py), and vendored or .venv trees. pytest's default import mode only clashes on same-basename test modules in package-less rootdir-relative directories. So an agent source file such as src/app/helpers.py, which shares a basename with a hidden or fixture helper (the docstring itself names `from helpers import …`), is deleted and breaks a correct solution. Limit the rule to collected test modules (test_*.py / *_test.py) in package-less directories that actually collide.
head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:1081 — `reserved` only takes the basenames of single-file overlays (owned leaves out directory overlays at :1079), so .py files that a directory overlay drops in (for example a whole hidden/tests dir) are never reserved. That contradicts the documented meaning, "agent-added .py files removed … in this grade" (:1071, header :223). Either count distinct paths or report per tree.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:806 — The KF-048 horizon is 2 × Σ watchdog_s / concurrency, but watchdog_s is already 2 × phase_sum (the worst-case kill deadline, :766), so it budgets four times the expected wall time. On --resume it also counts the whole recorded plan, including trials already rowed (:116). A full-suite or late-resume batch then needs a token valid for weeks, longer than a codex access token lives. The pre-flight would refuse batches that would actually finish in time, and the only fix offered is "run codex login", which does not help. Use the remaining (un-rowed) trials and one watchdog factor.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:831 — The pre-flight only compares the JWT exp. The codex CLI also refreshes on its own schedule, based on auth.json last_refresh. Now that pipeline-run.sh copies a placeholder refresh_token, a host login older than the CLI's refresh interval passes this check, but every container then tries to refresh, fails and loses its codex voice. That is the degraded-row outcome KF-048 is meant to stop. Check last_refresh against the same horizon too, or document why it cannot trigger.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:503 — suite_kind_cap is meant to refuse a present but malformed entry ("never skipped", :499 and header :190). In fact `run_usd_by_type: false`, `{build: null}` and `{build: false}` all collapse to "" through `//` and silently fall back to the single cap. `{build: 0}` passes usd_ok, so every build trial is dispatched with --max-run-usd 0. Test for presence with has($k) and reject non-positive amounts.
head/evals/harness/run-ablation.sh:510 — Precedence change: caps.run_usd_by_type now outranks the operator's .loa.config.yaml evals.ablation.run_cap_usd. Before this change that setting beat the suite's caps.run_usd. With this suite always carrying both kinds, the config knob no longer has any effect on dispatch, yet MANIFEST caps.run_usd still records it. Nothing warns that it was ignored.
head/evals/tests/run-ablation.bats:95 — This comment says "A0 BARE stays 70 min … the PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX derivation (80) does not apply". The assertion on the next lines expects 9600 s (80 min), and RAB-27 (:104) asserts an 80-min BARE budget. The comment contradicts the test it documents, and with the suite's phase_defaults BARE: 70 the 80 can only come from per-task bounds that the comment does not mention.
Verdict: CHANGES_REQUIRED

content.text:
The verdict is **CHANGES_REQUIRED**, mainly because the new grader rule can mark correct solutions as failing. The review is in `/workspace/review.md`: nine findings, one per line, then the verdict line. I didn't run the test suites, because the frozen PR doesn't include the rest of the repository (task fixtures, `grimoires/`, the seed scripts). Everything below comes from reading the code, plus a few jq checks I ran by hand.

**What blocks the merge:** grader 1.2.11's new step that removes colliding test files (`remove_colliding` in `ablation-grade.sh`).
- **No real collision needed (line 1096):** it deletes any agent `.py` file that shares a basename with a hidden or fixture test file, without checking that a file with that name is actually in the grading tree. If an agent legitimately moves a fixture test to a new folder, the moved test gets deleted. That is the same mis-grading the change is meant to prevent.
- **Matches far too much (line 1093):** it isn't limited to test modules in folders without `__init__.py`, which is the only case where pytest actually clashes. Any source module, package file or `.venv` file with a matching name is removed, for example an agent's own `src/app/helpers.py`.
- **Misses folder overlays (line 1081):** test files that a hidden folder overlay drops in are never checked, so those collisions still break pytest collection.
- **Inflated count (line 1019):** `colliding_tests_removed` is added up across the final, base and both snapshot trees, so one removed file can be reported as 3.

**Other findings:**
- **Codex token pre-flight:**
  - The required horizon is about four times the expected wall time, because the watchdog value it sums already has a 2× margin. On `--resume` it also counts trials that already finished. So it will refuse large batches and late resumes that would have finished before the token expired.
  - It only checks the token's `exp`. If the codex CLI also refreshes based on `last_refresh` (I couldn't confirm that from here), runs would still fail now that the refresh token is a placeholder.
- **Per-kind caps:**
  - Entries set to `false` or `null` silently fall back to the single cap, even though the code says malformed entries are refused.
  - An entry of `0` is accepted, so every trial of that kind would get `--max-run-usd 0`.
  - The suite's per-kind caps now override the operator's `evals.ablation.run_cap_usd` setting, so that setting no longer has any effect, with no warning.
- **Test comment (`run-ablation.bats:95`):** the comment says the A0 BARE budget "stays 70 min", but the assertion right after it, and test RAB-27, expect 80 minutes.

I left one thing out of the file: `seed-bugfix.bats` and `seed-refactor.bats` now pass a `--suite-version` flag to the seed scripts, which aren't part of this PR. If those scripts don't already accept that flag, both tests will fail.
